newest_union_closed_combinatorics_record.title: Frankl's Conjecture at Height Four and the Structure of Height-Five Counterexamples
newest_union_closed_combinatorics_record.author: Chenxiao Tian
newest_union_closed_combinatorics_record.relevance_to_explicit_entropy_constant: none at theorem level. Poset-height route: proves Frankl for every union-closed family of height <= 4 (empty-set-free form; <= 5 with the empty set) and constrains height-five counterexamples (even cardinality 2t, >= 3 critical elements, t >= 2n-1, critical join-cover number 3 or 4). It proves no universal frequency constant. Verified at theorem level by reading the full v1 HTML (67,063 characters of extracted text): zero occurrences of 'entropy', 'entropic', 'Gilmer', 'Sawin', 'coupling', 'constant lower bound', or the string '0.38'.

liu_conditionality_verbatim: Under numerically verified hypotheses, the lower bound for the union-closed sets conjecture can be improved to approximately 0.38271, a number that can be defined as the solution to an analytic equation. (arXiv:2306.08824, abstract, still v1 of 2023-06-15: no revision has removed the conditionality)
yu_cambie_value_verbatim: the best constant obtainable through this approach is around 0.38234, as evaluated by Yu and Cambie. (arXiv:2306.08824, abstract)
no_near_collision_note: The published Yu/Cambie ceiling is 0.38234 (locally certified as psi+3e-4 = 0.3823455), NOT 0.38284. A search-engine synthesis was observed conflating the two ('0.38234 (approximately 0.38284)'); that conflation is false and is recorded here so it is not mistaken for a near-collision with c'' = 0.38284565599065407172... . The nearest published decimal to c'' is Liu's conditional 0.38271, which c' = 0.38270908791873502993... makes unconditional and which c'' exceeds by 1.37e-4.
conclusion: No arXiv record collides at theorem level with either local result: c' = 1 - m* = 0.38270908791873502993... (Liu's conditional value, made unconditional) or c'' = 1 - m_{16/25} = 0.38284565599065407172... (a strictly larger constant from the scaled Example-5 protocol f(x) = (4/5)x(1-x)). The published progression remains 0.01 (2211.09055) -> (3-sqrt5)/2 (2211.11689, 2211.11731, 2211.11504) -> ~0.38234 (2212.12500, Yu Entropy 25 (2023) 767) -> ~0.38271 stated conditionally (2306.08824). No record was found treating the scaled family f_lambda(x) = lambda x (1-x).
